name: Allwinner Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Allwinner Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of intelligent application system-on-a-chip (SoC), analog components, and wireless connectivity integrated circuits in China and internationally. The company also provides a customer service platform that provides comprehensive product package download and online technical support services for chip agents, solution providers, channel partners, and enterprise customers. In addition, it engages in trading and software development activities. The company's products are used in tablets, business displays, smart industry, smart electric power, automotive electronics, …
